name: Deakin University
description: Deakin University is a public university founded in 1974, with campuses in Melbourne (Burwood), Geelong and Warrnambool. It teaches across business, engineering, health, law and the arts.
whyIncluded: Deakin College, Deakin's pathway college, accepts two H2 passes in GCE A-Levels for its diploma, which leads into first or second year of a Deakin degree.

livingCosts.summary: Deakin publishes no dollar figures, so this is the Australian Government's student-visa living-cost minimum of A$29,710 a year (about A$2,476 a month), split into rent, food, transport and personal using the pattern of other Australian universities. Geelong is cheaper.
livingCosts.notes: Rung C. Tried for rung A/B: deakin.edu.au 'Cost of living and studying in Melbourne' and '...in Geelong' story pages (no dollar amounts; only percentages such as Geelong rent '20-30% lower than Melbourne' and overall living costs 'approximately 12% less'; both point to the Study Australia calculator and cite Numbeo for comparisons), 'Living in Australia' and 'Living costs' international pages (qualitative only), and the international 'Fees and scholarships' page (no living-cost total). The university cost-of-living URL under /study/study-at-deakin/ returns 404. Figure used: Department of Home Affairs Student visa (subclass 500) financial capacity requirement for the primary applicant, A$29,710 for 12 months of living costs, in force since 10 May 2024 and still current as at 2026-10-08 (the Home Affairs page itself rendered only navigation in the fetch; the amount and date were confirmed from two 2026 secondary summaries of the Home Affairs requirement). Monthly = 29,710 / 12 = 2,475.83, split with the brief's Australian average shares housing .64 / food .22 / transport .04 / personal .11 (these shares sum to 1.01, so the four categories total A$2,500.58). Excludes tuition, OSHC, travel and the separate visa amounts for dependants. Cross-check: Monash (Melbourne, rung A) is higher at about A$4,368/month; the Home Affairs figure is the visa minimum, and Deakin's own page says Melbourne rents are higher than Geelong. Rechecked 2026-10-13: deakin.edu.au 'Accommodation and living costs' international page (no dollar figures; points to the Study Australia calculator). The Deakin College pre-departure handbook (A$30,000 a year, itemised) is from the Navitas-run pathway college, not Deakin University, so not used.
